notes: The GM teleport places (docs/PLAYTEST.md §7 "Teleport places"), merged after the world manifest places (the textzonename.txt areas and beach-south): a place here replaces a manifest place of the same name and takes over the names in its aliases (beach-south). The town spawn (jangan, spawn) comes from towns.json and is not listed here.

Every wave that adds somewhere worth visiting adds it here (docs/BACKLOG.md). A row: { name (kebab-case, at most 32 characters), group (town | fields | coast | bosses | other), x, y (the height hint: tp stands on the open surface nearest it), z (glTF metres), aliases? }. At start the server checks each row by the tp rule (open ground in the town spawn's walkable component within 10 m, inside the world bounds) and logs and skips a row that fails.

Rows with a snap are computed on the real export by the places tool (pnpm --filter @sro/server places [--write]; apps/server/src/cli/places.ts). near: the nearest open point to a hand-picked spot. area: inside a zones.json area by the GM where name, 16 m inside the world bounds, dry (not under a retail water plane); with shore, its lowest open point at least aboveSeaM over the sea level (the beach, not the cliff behind it), else the nearest open point to its mean centre. nest: the nearest open point to a nest centre. Open = standing by the placement rule, an open terrain cell, 1.5 m of standing ground around. Rows without a snap are hand-authored; the tool only checks them.

Coast: the in-bounds coast a player can stand on. Tiger Beach, Tiger Cape, Tomb Ridge Beach, River Mouth, South-East Cape, Jangan Bay and Canyon Beach lie wholly in the sea ring outside the walkable bounds of jangan-fields, so they have no place. east-shelf-beach and western-strait are the in-bounds strip the HUD names after them: a cliff and a ridge over the water. The Western China side across the strait and the land bridge toward Donwhang are open sea now (content/coast/coast.json drown, docs/COAST.md §4.1), so no place lies there.

north-gate: Jangan's outer wall has no north opening; the north gate is the palace's big gate at the north end of the plaza avenue, where Soldier Choiyoung [Teleport] stands guard. Bosses: tiger-camp-1 .. 11 are Tiger Girl's eleven camps (nests.json uniqueGroup) in nest id order.
